name: ai-chat
description: AI company v4: Claude plans and verifies, cheaper worker AI CLIs do the bulk work (router + sandboxed dispatcher); plus the experimental ai-chat session adapters.

scripts.check: npm run check:chat && npm run check:company
scripts.check:chat: node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/bridge-core.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/codex-session.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/adapter-router.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/relay-core.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/relay-cli.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/antigravity-session.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/workbuddy-localassistant.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/antigravity-sidecar.mjs && node --check skills/ai-chat/scripts/workbuddy-session.mjs
scripts.check:company: python3 -m py_compile skills/ai-company/bin/route.py skills/ai-company/bin/board.py && bash -n skills/ai-company/bin/dispatch.sh && bash -n skills/ai-company/bin/snap.sh && bash -n skills/ai-company/install.sh
